description: F-THREAD-05 — M8 × 1 FINE-pitch geometric thread. Verifies that the ISO_M_FINE catalog row drives the helix pitch (the spec called out fine pitch as separately required because the coarse-pitch tab in the wizard hides the '×P' designator).
notes: ISO M fine: M8 nominal × 1 mm pitch (vs M8 coarse = 1.25 mm pitch).
Designation uses the canonical × (U+00D7), not 'x' — same as ISO_M_FINE_TABLE in threadCatalog.ts.
20 mm / 1.0 mm pitch = 20 full turns — the highest turn count of the four fixtures, exercises the sampling-cap path.
Callout 'M8×1-6g ↧ 20' — fine pitch is ALWAYS printed (vs coarse which suppresses the ×P).
